sourceMethod: 720x600 sRGB RGBA/8 Krita document at 6 px per world unit. Hand-specified Bézier/Catmull-Rom shapes (QPainter) written to named layers in part groups: hair-back, ears, head-skin (base, clipped shade, clipped blush, line), face-eyes/{open,happy}, face-brows/{neutral,raised}, face-mouth/{neutral,happy,talking}, face-nose, hair-front (base with overlapping locks, clipped shade, clipped sheen and strands, line). Tapered ribbon strokes for lashes, brows and strand lines; shading softened with Krita's Gaussian blur. Two refinement passes (eyes, hair silhouette). Expression renders toggle the slot/attachment layers only.
colourSources: Sampled from the master: hair #402e2f, skin #fdc695, iris #070302, shirt #fdd653, blush #fdaf80, mouth #da412f.

generativeModelUsed: No image-generation model. Shapes and colours were authored as code by the assistant.
